name: test-failure
description: Label a failing test run so the control session knows where to look first.

cause.instructions: `output` is the tail of a failing pytest or bats run. Which best describes the most likely cause?

criteria.flaky: The failure depends on chance or timing: random rolls, ordering, sleeps, or it is reported as intermittent.
criteria.environment: Missing tool, wrong path, missing dependency, permission or network error; the code under test never really ran.
criteria.regression: An assertion about game or script behavior fails because the code under test now behaves differently.
criteria.test-bug: The test itself is wrong: bad fixture, invalid input it builds, or an assertion that contradicts the documented behavior.
